title: Better Health Indicators
description: A damage indicator mod that displays floating hearts on top of players, with many features to control them.
body:
# Better Health Indicators

A clients-side mod that displays the health of other players in a multiplayer server.

Excellent for use in **PVP** servers and **SMPs**.
## 
## Features:
- Displays player health above their heads.
- Real-time health updates.
- Lightweight and performance-friendly.
- Works on most multiplayer servers(Some servers have functionality to disable it).

There are many more features to come to this mod.
